prompt: In one paragraph, explain what a hash function is to a designer.

sampler.note: LLaDA-style low-confidence remasking, 4 blocks of 32 (the model card default)

answer: A hash function is a mathematical function that takes an input value and produces a unique output value, which is typically an integer. It is used to map data to a unique identifier, which can be used to identify and store data. Hash functions are used in various applications, such as data compression, data storage, and data retrieval. A good hash function should be fast, efficient, and resistant to collisions, which can occur when two different input values produce the same output value. A good hash function should also be resistant to attacks, such as rainbow attacks.
